reason: The README describes a host plugin for coordinating live Agent Sessions through peer consultation, forked channels, shared task boards, asynchronous replies, and explicit alignment with an original Session; orchestration is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中让智能体向其他实时会话发起有上下文的咨询，并通过分叉会话、共享任务板和异步回复协同工作。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets Agents consult live peer Sessions with shared context, forked channels, task boards, and asynchronous replies.

capabilities: Queries live peer Sessions using bounded questions and task context
Creates and reuses forked consultation Sessions
Can explicitly write consultation results into an original Session
Maintains shared consultation boards and asynchronous reply queues
Can access or modify the shared workspace through inherited Session tools and permissions
